label: Fires at D2 after an unrewarded visit to S1, strongest when a1 led there.
short_terms: (phase == D2) * last_is("a1 S1 u") ;; (phase == D2) * (prev_state == 1) * (prev_reward == 0) ;; (phase == D2) * (prev_state == 2)
terms: (phase == D2) * last_is("a1 S1 u") ;; (phase == D2) * last_is("a2 S1 u") ;; (phase == D2) * (prev_state == 2) ;; (phase == D2) * last_is("a1 S1 u") * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == D2) * last_is("a1 S1 u") * (action == 1) ;; (phase == D2) * last_is("a2 S1 u") * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == D2) * last_is("a2 S1 r") ;; (phase == D2) * (prev_state == 1) * (prev_reward == 0) * belief_lo
explanation: Active only at D2 (zero at D1/GO); timing baseline rises over the episode. Magnitude is driven by the previous trial: after a1 -> S1 unrewarded (common, unrewarded) it gains ~+1.0-1.2; after a2 -> S1 unrewarded (rare, unrewarded) a smaller ~+0.16; after any trial that reached S2 it is lowered (~-0.19). This trial choice/state, belief and hidden good state add little. The free fit adds a bump when the trial before was also unrewarded, a slight extra when a1 is chosen again, and a negative for a2 S1 r, but only raises dev R^2 from 0.64 to 0.66. All terms are observed (action at D2 is already known).

issues: The label leaves out that the feature sits near zero at D2 after any S2 visit. The prev_state==2 term (weight -0.19) cancels the D2 timing baseline. After S1 rewarded it stays near the baseline level (about 0.2), not zero. So 'fires only after unrewarded S1' is slightly too strong, but the ranking is correct: a1 S1 u (+1.04) >> a2 S1 u (+0.16) > S1 rewarded > S2.

After a2 S1 u the activation is bimodal: the worst misses show values of about 1.7-2.0 where about 0.4 is predicted. Splitting by the trial before (reward, state, action), this choice, belief sign or stay barely changes test R^2 (0.63-0.651 vs 0.644), so this variance is still unexplained.
Restating terms 2-3 as last_is('a2 S1 u') gives the identical score (0.6437), so the short form is a clean description. It is not curve fitting.
The misses table shows no large systematic error. The biggest cell is D2 after a2 S1 r at -0.126, a small over-prediction. D1 and GO are correctly zero.

Small optional gains: an a1 S1 u x ep_dec interaction reaches 0.649 test, and a2 S1 u x (tv('reward',-2)==0) reaches 0.651. Both are marginal. The short form is 0.644 against an observed-only ceiling of 0.69.
